name: How do I prepare my yard for pergola construction?

mainEntity.name: How do I prepare my yard for pergola construction?

acceptedAnswer.text: Preparing your yard for pergola construction typically involves clearing the designated area of any debris, plants, or obstacles. It's also essential to ensure the ground is level and that you have identified the location of any underground utilities, such as irrigation lines or electrical cables, by calling 811. Having a clear and accessible workspace before our team arrives helps to ensure a smooth and efficient installation process for your project.
acceptedAnswer.description: Prepare your yard by clearing the area, ensuring it's level, and marking underground utilities to ensure smooth construction.
